harness_surface.system_prompt: CLAUDE.md (Role, Members, How the work goes)
harness_surface.guardrails: CLAUDE.md (What this hub does not do) + .claude/settings.json deny
harness_surface.scripts: src/hub.py; src/bridge.py, the builder's bridge copied by the build

note: A hub agent over the agents of one request (meta_agent/tasks/033; the person, 2026-11-20, 'A hub bundle (Recommended)', 'Assign freely, carry on my word (Recommended)', 'Pointer to a card (Recommended)', 'Ask once per question (Recommended)', 'until solve the problem'). A build copies this tree, fills CLAUDE.md's placeholders, writes members.json (card hub_members) naming each member by its agent, its build, its folder relative to the hub's and the sha256 of its build card, refusing a member whose bundle is not the digest its build card states, and copies the builder's bridge into src/bridge.py, byte for byte, recording its hash on the build card. The hub carries no tool, no gate, no envelope and no library skill: src/hub.py writes the person's question and the list of assignments from the session's words, the person's agreement to the list once, verbatim, carries an assignment of an agreed list to its member and a member's result back on the hub's trigger, and a hand-over between members only on the person's word with their words, opens a member's session fresh in the member's folder on the model, effort and permission mode the person gave, and reads the states of the results; it reads no value to judge it. The members' folders are named in members.json as ../<agent>-<NNNN>, beside the hub's, as a test run lays bundles out. A member must be of an agent template that answers an assignment (v35 or later); the builder refuses one that does not. v2 (meta_agent/tasks/034; hub-1, hub-2 and hub-3 of meta_agent/failures.jsonl): carry refuses an assignment to a member that takes a hand-over from another member before it has crossed; members lists each member's parameter rows, whether each holds a value, who chose it and on what basis; words appends the person's words given after the agreement to the question's next revision, verbatim, and round writes the next round of an assignment of the agreed list, naming its list item and quoting parts of those words character for character, with no new agreement (the person, 2026-11-21, 'Append to the question (Recommended)', 'Next round quotes them (Recommended)'); src/bridge.py is contracts/tools/bridge.py as it stands since its list_item line. v3 (meta_agent/tasks/034; hub-5, hub-6 and hub-7 of meta_agent/failures.jsonl, read from run multiscale/20261121-1): status lists what is held from the latest result of each assignment of the list alone, so that what a later round answered is not reported held; round takes what the round asks from the session's words (--asks), refusing a digit in them, and no longer copies the list item's asks beside quotes that may say otherwise; round may be written before any round of its list item has been carried, so that the first carry of an item already quotes the person's later words, a round not yet carried is superseded by a later one, and carry refuses all but the latest round of an item; run-hub and CLAUDE.md say so. src/bridge.py is unchanged from v2.
